description: This file is an HTML source file for a web-based database viewer interface. It contains the structure, styling, and client-side JavaScript code for browsing and viewing database tables and data.
external_files: External API endpoints accessed via fetch: /api/databases, /api/{db}/tables, /api/{db}/tables/{tableName}/data

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of available databases.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, resetting current selections.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables within the selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data from the selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Creates an HTML table from data rows.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Generates HTML for individual cell based on data type and length.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content to show full data or truncated preview.
